messages:
elaine: Quick check — Velvet dark theme iteration attached. Focus: chart contrast and code syntax readability in the log viewer.

sam: looks nice overall. main worry is area chart fill vs grid lines. fills are pretty close to grid color :eyes:

mahira: Agree. Ran a quick contrast check — background #0b0f12, grid #1b2428 -> ratio ~3.1:1, need >=4.5:1 for small UI text. Charts are borderline.

elaine: good call. For context, grid lines are purely decorative — do we need to bump them or reduce weight?

sam: I'd rather darken grid to #12181b or lower alpha on fills. Also syntax tokens: pink string color looks washed on code blocks.

juan: re: syntax, try swapping token colors: strings #ffb86b, keywords #9be3ff, comments #6b7b86. Those hit ~7:1 on #0b0f12.

isha: can we avoid too many saturated yellows? on graphs they pop and look like "alert" colors. maybe use desaturated orange #d38f5a instead.

mahira: accessibility nit: line chart points at small sizes need focus ring or contrast change on hover for keyboard users.

elaine: noted. Also feedback from product: token heatmap needs a distinct palette for high-mid-low buckets. Current purple->cyan isn't clear for colorblind.

sam: proposal: diverging palette blue -> muted magenta for mid -> warm orange for high. code: 
```css
--color-velvet-bg: #0b0f12;
--color-velvet-grid: #12181b;
--color-syntax-string: #ffb86b;
--color-syntax-keyword: #9be3ff;
```

juan: threw those into the viz mock, added legend tweaks (bold label, 14px), looks better. screenshot uploaded :thumbsup: 

design-bot: Contrast scan complete: 18 elements checked, 5 fails. Failing items: small grid lines, chart tooltip text, code inline keywords. See /design/contrast-report/1825123456

elaine: thanks bot. can someone take the failing list and spin a tiny PR? target: fix grid and tooltip today.

mahira: I'll do grid + tooltips. Will push a tiny change to reduce grid alpha and increase tooltip bg to #1b2529. PR shortly.

sam: I'll adjust syntax colors and update storybook. I'll avoid bright yellows for charts.

isha: i'll rework the heatmap legend for colorblind-safe palette and add pattern overlay option for high importance states.

elaine: perfect. let's meet 11:15 for a quick sync if needed. If not, mark this thread resolved :white_check_mark:

sam: ack :white_check_mark:

juan: ack

mahira: on it

design-bot: PR 982 created by mahira: https://git.internal/redwood/velvet-theme/pull/982 (:eyes: awaiting review)
